subject: DHCP pool exhaustion causing devices to fail connection at Perambur outlet
description: Multiple customer and staff devices are unable to connect to the Wi-Fi network at ServeWell - Perambur. When attempting to join the network, devices either fail to obtain an IP address or experience prolonged connection timeouts. The issue began approximately 2 hours ago during the lunch rush. We suspect the DHCP pool on router RTR-0089-01 has been exhausted, preventing new device connections. Currently affecting POS systems and customer-facing tablets.

ticket_history.note: Ticket received and acknowledged. Initial troubleshooting steps recommended: restart router and verify DHCP configuration. Awaiting store feedback.
